name: Shelly Plus Plug S (EU)

radios.note: Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n plus Bluetooth 4.2 (ESP32), per the V2 spec table.

matter.note: No Shelly page found that states Matter support for the Plus (Gen2) Plug S; Shelly's Matter plugs are Gen3/Gen4. Not confirmed either way.

apple_home.note: Shelly's Apple Home page covers Matter-capable Gen3/Gen4 devices; nothing found that covers the Plus Plug S.

google_home.note: Through Shelly's cloud integration with Google.

alexa.note: Through Shelly's cloud integration with Alexa.

smartthings.note: Cloud-to-cloud integration maintained by Shelly; listed on the Shelly product page.

home_assistant.note: Official local Shelly integration; Gen2+ devices use RPC and need no extra configuration.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi device; the user guide says the Shelly app and cloud are not required for it to work.

localControl.note: Local RPC used by Home Assistant; MQTT and scripting are supported on the device.

energyMonitoring.note: Reports live power and energy consumption.

maxLoadWatts.note: 12 A / 2500 W rating; the app's max-power limit goes up to 2500 W.

summary: The Shelly Plus Plug S is a compact Wi-Fi and Bluetooth plug for Schuko (Type F) sockets, rated 12 A / 2500 W with power and energy metering. It works without a hub, connects to Alexa, Google and SmartThings through Shelly's cloud, and to Home Assistant locally. Shelly has since moved to Gen3 and Gen4 plugs that add Matter.
caveats: Two hardware revisions exist (V1 and V2, model numbers SNPL-00112EU and SNPL-10112EU); check which one you have.
Indoor use only, per the Shelly user and safety guide.
